summary: Transaction 3461032 ($129.94) on card C08168-K1 was flagged by monitoring due to the appearance of device D004630, the central device defining fraud ring 57672119. Graph analysis revealed that device D004630 operated behind an anonymous proxy across three distinct card accounts within a 30-hour window and is linked to four confirmed fraud closed cases (CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, and CC-3035). Conversely, the transaction carried a very low model score of 0.002, matched the cardholder's general product history, and had not yet been disputed by the customer. Due to the tension between the low model score and strong cross-card graph signals, the verdict remains uncertain with an assessed fraud probability of 0.191. A case was opened, connected cards were placed on monitoring, and the file was escalated to an analyst for review.
